## B0001

[Lines 1–1](../../../CMakeLists.txt#L1); `build-command`; `contains_scoped_manual_contract`.

The contract is scoped to its anchor, not a proof of every declaration sharing this line range.

```text
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)

```

| Field | Reviewed usage contract |
| --- | --- |
| purpose | Require the declared CMake language/tool behavior floor before processing the project. |
| inputs / outputs | Arguments: VERSION 3.25. Scope: top level. |
| invariants | Lexical scope: top level. The command changes configure/generate metadata only; it is not executed by the compiled CROWN runtime. |
| ownership | CMake configure state owns variable/property VERSION 3.25; downstream targets consume it only through the declared scope. |
| failure | CMake versions below the declared minimum are rejected before project generation. |
| cost | Small configure-time variable/property bookkeeping; no compiled CROWN runtime or per-query cost. |
| Design | [CMakeLists.txt](../../../CMakeLists.txt), [docs/native_build.md](../../native_build.md) |
